allowed_urls.title: Allowed URLs
allowed_urls.description: URL prefixes events may name their own url within (a prefix matches itself, and what follows it after a / or ?). Without them, an event can't choose a URL.

ack.title: Acknowledge
ack.description: write: once the message is written to the connection (at most once over the wire: a message in flight when the connection drops is lost). reply: once the server answered it (at least once).

message_type.title: Message type
message_type.description: For events that don't set one. Text must be UTF-8.

request_id_path.title: Request id path
request_id_path.description: ack reply: a JSON path (e.g. id or meta.request_id) where a generated id (or the event's correlation_id) is put into the outgoing JSON. Without it, the data must carry the event's correlation_id itself.

reply_id_path.title: Reply id path
reply_id_path.description: ack reply: where a reply's id is in the incoming JSON.

reply_error_path.title: Reply error path
reply_error_path.description: ack reply: a reply with a value here (not null or false) is a failure (NACK, not retried).

reply_timeout_ms.title: Reply timeout (ms)
reply_timeout_ms.description: ack reply: no reply in time is a retryable NACK.

authorization.title: Authorization
authorization.description: The Authorization header's value (e.g. Bearer …), for every URL.

tls_ca.title: CA certificate
tls_ca.description: Uploaded PEM file with the CA(s) of the server's certificate. Default: the bundled Mozilla roots.

tls_cert.title: Client certificate
tls_cert.description: Uploaded PEM file: a client certificate (mTLS), with tls_key.

tls_key.title: Client key
tls_key.description: Uploaded PEM file: the client certificate's private key.

insecure_skip_verify.title: Skip certificate checks
insecure_skip_verify.description: Development only: accept any server certificate.

lazy_connect.title: Connect lazily
lazy_connect.description: Connect with the first event instead of at start (where a wrong URL or credentials show at once).

ping_interval_s.title: Ping interval (s)
ping_interval_s.description: A ping unanswered by the next one means a dead connection (then it's redialled).

max_message_bytes.title: Max message size
max_message_bytes.description: Bytes, sent or received; a larger event is rejected (not retried).

max_connections.title: Max connections
max_connections.description: One per URL; when full, the longest-idle one is closed.

idle_timeout_s.title: Idle timeout (s)
idle_timeout_s.description: A connection to an event's URL unused this long is closed (never the url's).

max_concurrent.title: Concurrent events
max_concurrent.description: Events handled at once. 1 keeps the order; more is for ack reply with a server that answers out of order.
